about: The look a character keeps from its creation: Visuals (the chosen visual resources: head, hair, horns, ...), Elements (material settings: makeup, tattoo, scars, with colour and intensity), AdditionalChoices, and the colour ids SkinColor, EyeColor, SecondEyeColor, HairColor. A change-appearance session can only be started on a character that carries it. Script Extender: CharacterCreationAppearance.

the handler of the Osiris call StartChangeAppearance (code:esv::OsirisGameFunctions::StartChangeAppearance) answers false for a character without this component

the origin character Astarion on the level Basic_Level_A carries it with all four colour ids null, while the definition of a change-appearance session started on him reads real ids for skin, hair and both eyes: an origin's colours come from elsewhere than this component

survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
